title: Probing Intersectional Biases in Vision-Language Models with Counterfactual Examples
reasoning: The paper includes 'religion' as one of the four primary attribute sets used to measure social bias in Vision-Language Models. It specifically generates and evaluates counterfactual examples involving religious identities (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu) to identify intersectional biases in how these models associate religion with occupations and personality traits.
